text: Ángela, a Madrid university student writing a thesis on audiovisual violence, finds her supervisor dead in a screening room and [takes the tape he was watching|trigger|bringing something home]. With Chema, a fellow student who collects violent videos, she discovers [a snuff film of a missing student|images|pictures, screens and recordings], shot on a particular Sony camera. The trail leads to a hidden tunnel beneath the school library and to Bosco, a charming young man who [wins over her family at dinner|rules|it wears a familiar face].
